property_summary: For any caller and any call-value, the reference requires exactly 1 ether to lock a guess so calls with value != 1 ether are rejected; the mutant allows value > 1 ether and thus accepts some calls (value > 1 ether) that the reference rejects.
change_summary: Replace the require that msg.value == 1 ether with require(msg.value >= 1 ether) allowing larger ether to be accepted and changing recorded behavior when callers send more than 1 ether.
